description: This file 'usp_register.c' contains implementation of functions registering various data model elements in a USP agent, including parameters, objects, operations, events, groups, and vendor hooks. It manages schema registration, instance handling, unique key registration, and vendor-specific callbacks.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_CoreVendorHooks(vendor_hook_cb_t * callbacks)
methods.description: Registers core vendor hook callbacks used by the core agent, allowing override of default behaviors.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_Param_Constant(char * path,char * value,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a parameter with a constant immutable value, often used for versioning or fixed options.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_Param_NumEntries(char * path,char * table_path)
methods.description: Registers a parameter representing the number of entries in a table, allowing dynamic counting.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_Param_SupportedList(char * path,const enum_entry_t * enums,int num_enums)
methods.description: Registers a parameter that contains a comma-separated list of supported enumerated values.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_DBParam_ReadWrite(char * path,char * value,dm_validate_value_cb_t validator_cb,dm_notify_set_cb_t notify_set_cb,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a read-write parameter persisted in the database, with optional validation and notification callbacks.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_DBParam_Secure(char * path,char * value,dm_validate_value_cb_t validator_cb,dm_notify_set_cb_t notify_set_cb)
methods.description: Registers a secure parameter (e.g., password) that is stored securely but returned as empty when read.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_DBParam_SecureWithType(char * path,char * value,dm_validate_value_cb_t validator_cb,dm_notify_set_cb_t notify_set_cb,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a secure parameter with explicit type flags.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_DBParam_ReadOnly(char * path,char * value,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a read-only parameter persisted in the database.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_VendorParam_ReadOnly(char * path,dm_get_value_cb_t get_cb,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a vendor-specific, read-only parameter with a callback to retrieve its value.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_VendorParam_ReadWrite(char * path,dm_get_value_cb_t get_cb,dm_set_value_cb_t set_cb,dm_notify_set_cb_t notify_set_cb,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a vendor-specific, read-write parameter with callbacks for get and set.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_GroupedVendorParam_ReadOnly(int group_id,char * path,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a grouped, read-only vendor parameter for optimized bulk retrieval.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_GroupedVendorParam_ReadWrite(int group_id,char * path,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a grouped, read-write vendor parameter group.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_DBParam_ReadOnlyAuto(char * path,dm_get_value_cb_t get_cb,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a read-only parameter with an auto-initialized value at creation.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_DBParam_ReadWriteAuto(char * path,dm_get_value_cb_t get_cb,dm_validate_value_cb_t validator_cb,dm_notify_set_cb_t notify_set_cb,unsigned type_flags)
methods.description: Registers a read-write parameter with a dynamically assigned initial value at creation.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_DBParam_Alias(char * path,dm_notify_set_cb_t notify_set_cb)
methods.description: Registers an 'Alias' parameter as a unique key in a table, validating its uniqueness.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_Object(char * path,dm_validate_add_cb_t validate_add_cb,dm_add_cb_t add_cb,dm_notify_add_cb_t notify_add_cb,dm_validate_del_cb_t validate_del_cb,dm_del_cb_t del_cb,dm_notify_del_cb_t notify_del_cb)
methods.description: Registers an object that supports add/delete operations, with optional validation and callbacks.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_Object_UniqueKey(char * path,char ** params,int num_params)
methods.description: Defines one or more parameters as the unique key (or compound key) for a multi-instance object.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_Object_RefreshInstances(char * path,dm_refresh_instances_cb_t refresh_instances_cb)
methods.description: Registers a callback to populate all instances of a top-level multi-instance object.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_GroupedObject(int group_id,char * path,bool is_writable)
methods.description: Registers an object as part of a group with shared add/delete vendor hooks.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_SyncOperation(char * path,dm_sync_oper_cb_t sync_oper_cb)
methods.description: Registers a synchronous custom operation with a vendor-defined callback.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_AsyncOperation(char * path,dm_async_oper_cb_t async_oper_cb,dm_async_restart_cb_t restart_cb)
methods.description: Registers an asynchronous operation with start and restart callbacks.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_AsyncOperation_MaxConcurrency(char * path,int max_concurrency)
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of concurrent invocations for an async operation.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_OperationArguments(char * path,char ** input_arg_names,int num_input_arg_names,char ** output_arg_names,int num_output_arg_names)
methods.description: Registers input/output argument names for an operation for reporting purposes.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_Event(char * path)
methods.description: Registers an event (marked with a trailing '!') in the data model.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_EventArguments(char * path,char ** event_arg_names,int num_event_arg_names)
methods.description: Defines the argument names carried by an event.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_GroupId(char * path,int group_id)
methods.description: Associates a data model element with a group ID, for categorization.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_GroupVendorHooks(int group_id,dm_get_group_cb_t get_group_cb,dm_set_group_cb_t set_group_cb,dm_add_group_cb_t add_group_cb,dm_del_group_cb_t del_group_cb)
methods.description: Registers vendor callback functions for a specific group, enabling batch parameter access.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_SubscriptionVendorHooks(int group_id,dm_subscribe_cb_t subscribe_cb,dm_unsubscribe_cb_t unsubscribe_cb)
methods.description: Registers vendor callbacks for subscribing/unsubscribing to parameter updates.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_MultiDeleteVendorHook(int group_id,dm_multi_del_cb_t multi_del_cb)
methods.description: Registers a vendor callback to delete multiple objects at once.

methods.name: int USP_REGISTER_CreateObjectVendorHook(int group_id,dm_create_obj_cb_t create_obj_cb)
methods.description: Registers a callback for creating object instances.

methods.name: int ValidateAliasParam(dm_req_t * req,char * value)
methods.description: Validates new alias parameter values, ensuring they are non-empty, start with a letter, and are unique.

methods.name: int ValidateParamUniqueness(dm_req_t * req,char * value)
methods.description: Checks that a parameter value is unique across all instances of a table.

ctags.name: USP_REGISTER_Object
ctags.pattern: /^int USP_REGISTER_Object(char *path, dm_validate_add_cb_t validate_add_cb, dm_add_cb_t add_cb, dm/
ctags.signature: (char * path,dm_validate_add_cb_t validate_add_cb,dm_add_cb_t add_cb,dm_notify_add_cb_t notify_add_cb,dm_validate_del_cb_t validate_del_cb,dm_del_cb_t del_cb,dm_notify_del_cb_t notify_del_cb)

ctags.name: usp_err_bad_scope_str
ctags.pattern: /^static char *usp_err_bad_scope_str = "ERROR: Function must be called from within context of VEND/
